name: BuildShotRay
signature: void __cdecl BuildShotRay(int player, float aim_x, float aim_y)
notes: Shot ray of a player: camera-space direction (aim_x, aim_y, -g_focalLengthPx) rotated by the camera matrix, then converted to world space. Hit tests use this ray, not screen coordinates.
Computes atan(320 / g_focalLengthPx) and atan(240 / g_focalLengthPx): the 4:3 half view angles (probably for culling). Must use the wider half width for widescreen.

name: IsInScreenRect
notes: Projects a camera-space point with g_focalLengthPx and checks |x| <= focal*0.5 (= 320) and -240 <= y <= 240. 4:3 bounds.
Calls InitInput (0x41DEC0) during startup.

name: UpdateAim
notes: Per player: maps the raw shot position (g_aim +0/+2) through MapAimAxis to centred aim coordinates, clamped to -320..319 and -240..239 (4:3), stored as shorts (+4/+6) and floats (+8/+0xC). Called from 0x40E5F0 after UpdateInput.

name: UpdateShots
notes: Takes the shot flags (TakeShotFlags) and the shot position (GetShotPosition) or both cursors, and stores them per player at 0x9C6A80 (x, y, on-screen flag +0x12, fired +0x14).

name: MoveAimDigital
notes: Moves the aim with digital directions (keyboard/joystick) and clamps it to +-320 / +-240 (4:3).

name: MapAimAxis
notes: Maps one raw aim coordinate through a calibration table (0x40D510) and reports whether it is inside [min, max] (UpdateAim passes -320..319 and -240..239).

name: UpdateLetterbox
notes: Cinematic letterbox task. Per state (g_letterboxState): loads identity, translates to (0, +-0.35, -1) in camera space and draws model 0x93E twice (top and bottom bar); state 1 slides the bars in over 40 frames, 3 out, 4 holds, 8 scales the bar to cover the screen. Sets g_cinemaMode. Only referenced as a task pointer.

name: SetupSceneProjection
notes: Projection = translate(g_projectionOffset) * SetPerspective(0x1D3B, 4/3, 0.8, 8000), then g_focalLengthPx = 240 / tan(20.55 deg). Replacing the 4/3 (immediate at 0x4185D4) gives a correct Hor+ 16:9 3D view (aspect_experiment).

name: DrawModelByIndex
notes: Draws model table entry `index` with the current matrix when its flags have 0x8000 and 1 (SubmitModel 0x4A96D0). Index 0 calls 0x4A6060 instead.

name: SetProjectionCenter
notes: g_projectionOffset = (x / 320 - 1, 1 - y / 240): moves the projection centre to screen point (x, y).

name: SetupProjectionNear
notes: Same projection as SetupSceneProjection with a given near plane; 4/3 immediate at 0x4195C2. Called from 0x40E620.

name: DrawSprite2D
notes: Draws a 2D sprite in 640x480 screen coordinates through SubmitSprite. 24 callers (HUD, menus, crosshair, title).

name: DrawSpriteAt
signature: void __cdecl DrawSpriteAt(int sprite, float x, float y, float depth, float scale_x, float scale_y, int p7, int p8)
notes: Builds a sprite record and calls DrawSprite2D. The 4th argument becomes the quad depth (sprite +1).
Reached from FrameWaitCallback (0x49E0C0) when more than 1 ms remains; continues into ProcessJobQueueEntry (0x41D620).

name: ProcessJobQueueEntry
notes: Pops one 16-byte entry from the 64-entry ring buffer g_jobQueue (0x7D8EB0) and handles it via DispatchJob (0x41D670). Job kinds are unknown.

name: DispatchJob
notes: Picks the handler for a job queue entry from g_jobHandlers (0x587C30) and calls it.

name: InitInput
notes: Clears the input globals, opens \\.\SEGAJOY.VXD, reads Hod2.ini (LoadControllerIni), creates the DirectInput devices (CreateInputDevices) and sets the player modes (ResolveControllerModes). Falls back to P1 mode 6 / P2 mode 0. Called from 0x40AB40.

name: LoadControllerIni
notes: Reads [Controller] PLAYER1_INDEX/DEVID and PLAYER2_INDEX/DEVID from Hod2.ini (default -1). Returns 1 when both indexes are below 8.

name: ResolveControllerModes
notes: Maps the Hod2.ini index to a device mode per player: 0 -> 0, 1 -> 3 (keyboard), 2 -> 6 (mouse + keyboard), 3+ -> index+4 (joystick, 7..12) when the enumerated device id matches DEVID; DEVID 0x104 selects the SEGAJOY gun (13/14). Returns 0 on a mismatch.

name: UpdateInput
notes: Per-frame input update. Reads joysticks, mouse and both keyboard layouts into raw records, then builds the player records of slot 0 (P1) and slot 6 (P2) from the player modes. Only caller: the call at 0x40E5F0. Reimplemented in src/platform/input/input.cpp.

name: GetCursorClientPos
notes: GetCursorPos minus ClientToScreen(g_hWnd, {0,0}): the cursor in client pixels.

name: GetPlayerInputRecord
notes: Returns &g_inputPlayerRecords[slot].

name: GetShotPosition
notes: Returns g_inputCursor of the slot stored at 0x7DB330 by TakeShotFlags.

name: TakeShotFlags
notes: For slots 0 and 6: a reload flag sets the cursor to (0xFFFF, 0xFFFF) (off screen) and selects the slot; a trigger flag selects the slot. Stores the slot at 0x7DB330 (-1 none) and clears both flags.

name: InjectTrigger
notes: Sets 0x7DB330 = slot and g_inputTriggerFlags[slot] = 1.

name: ConsumeCursorCallback
notes: Calls the one-shot g_inputCursorCallback and clears it; returns 1 when none is set. UpdateInput reads the cursor only when this returns 1.

name: SetCursorCallback
notes: Stores g_inputCursorCallback. Called from 0x40D480.

name: CreateInputDevices
notes: DirectInputCreateEx(0x700), keyboard (buffer 16) and mouse devices, then EnumDevices(DIDEVTYPE_JOYSTICK) with EnumJoystickCallback and Acquire on every joystick.

name: EnumJoystickCallback
notes: Creates the joystick device, SetDataFormat, SetCooperativeLevel(g_hWnd, exclusive | background), axis range and dead zone. Marks a player mode with 0x80000000 when the product name equals the string at 0x587D88 (gun joystick). Up to 8 devices. Only passed as a pointer, so Ghidra auto-analysis misses it.

name: CreateInputDevice
signature: HRESULT __cdecl CreateInputDevice(IDirectInputDevice7A **out, HWND window, GUID guid, const DIDATAFORMAT *format, DWORD cooperative)
notes: CreateDeviceEx, SetDataFormat and SetCooperativeLevel for the keyboard and the mouse.

name: ReadKeyboard
notes: Clears and reads the key state and buffered key events, then maps the keys of layout 0 (arrows/numpad, Enter, Space, numpad +) or layout 1 (D/A/W/X, LShift, Tab unless Alt, LCtrl). Both layouts share one previous-state variable.

name: ReadMouse
notes: Mouse buttons: left = trigger 0x04, right = reload 0x02, middle = start 0x08.

name: ReadGunJoystick
signature: int __cdecl ReadGunJoystick(ButtonRecord *record, int device, int slot)
notes: Reader for a joystick marked as a gun: x/y to g_inputCursor[slot], button 0 trigger, 1 reload, 4 start, POV to directions. Calls 0x49DA90 on a new trigger press. Not reimplemented (no device to verify).

name: ReadSegaGun
signature: int __cdecl ReadSegaGun(ButtonRecord *record, int gun, int slot)
notes: Reader for the SEGAJOY.VXD light gun through DeviceIoControl(0x1005) commands 0x31..0x33. The driver cannot load on modern Windows. Not reimplemented.

name: ReadJoystick
notes: Poll + GetDeviceState(DIJOYSTATE2). Stick beyond +-0x40 gives directions, buttons 0..13 map through g_inputJoystickButtonMap.
Projects an object with g_focalLengthPx and tests its screen box against +-320 (4:3). Visibility check; must widen for widescreen.
Converts the 4:3 screen edge (320) back to camera space with g_focalLengthPx.
Same screen box test against +-320 as 0x445530 for another object type.

name: DrawCrosshair
notes: Draws the crosshair sprite at (aim_x + 320, 240 - aim_y) with DrawSprite2D.

Draws a full-screen 640x480 picture as 5 x 15 tiles of 128x32 (sprites 0x6E2..0x72C, textures 0xDA4..0xDEE) plus five 128x512 strips (sprites 0xAB1..). Registered as a draw callback by 0x495EA0. Not the cinematic letterbox (checked); which screen it is is unknown.
Called by ReadGunJoystick (0x41F000) on a new trigger press, then the trigger is blocked for 6 frames. Purpose unknown.

name: DrawScreenFlash
notes: Full-screen XYZRHW quad (0..639 x 0..479) with alpha: the shot flash ([Flush Setting]). Calls the XYZRHW draw directly, not DrawScreenQuad.
Function start that the sampling profiler reported as a hotspot (47%); the real hot call site was 0x4A4D30. Not found by Ghidra auto-analysis.

name: FrameWaitCallback
notes: Default g_frameWaitCallback (stored at 0x49DF0B). Called by WaitFrameEnd on every spin with the remaining ms; runs one queued job via 0x41D5D0 when more than 1.0 ms remains. Not called directly, so Ghidra auto-analysis does not create it. frame_wait_sleep replaces the pointer.

name: WaitFrameEnd
notes: Busy-waits with QueryPerformanceCounter until the target frame time (g_frameTimeMs 16.67 ms plus correction g_frameCorrectionMs). Called from 0x4A59DF and 0x4AB2F0. Possibly D3DX UpdateFrame. Main CPU 100% hotspot.

name: DrawStrip3D
notes: IDirect3DDevice7::DrawPrimitive(TRIANGLESTRIP, XYZ|NORMAL|TEX1 (0x112)).

name: DrawStripScreen
notes: IDirect3DDevice7::DrawPrimitive(TRIANGLESTRIP, XYZRHW|DIFFUSE|SPECULAR|TEX1 (0x1C4)): pre-transformed screen vertices. Only callers: DrawScreenQuad and DrawScreenFlash.

name: DrawList3D
notes: IDirect3DDevice7::DrawPrimitive(TRIANGLELIST, 0x112).
WinMain-like initialization function found by Ghidra auto-analysis. Contains the main window CreateWindowExA (returns to 0x4A588B) and the removed CheckCdRom call (0x4A5899).

name: CheckCdRom
notes: Passes when g_cdCheckMode (0x7DC890) is 0 or CDCheckPass (0x40) is set in g_hglCoreFlags; otherwise scans GetLogicalDriveStringsA for GetDriveTypeA() == DRIVE_CDROM. No callers in the supported build (call removed at 0x4A5899), so Ghidra auto-analysis does not create it.

name: GetHglCoreIniPath
notes: With a NULL argument uses the default name "hglCore.ini" (g_defaultHglCoreIniName) and stores GetFullPathNameA of it in g_hglCoreIniPath (0x7DD660). Relative to the current directory.

name: LoadHglCoreIni
notes: Reads the [HGLCORE] keys with GetPrivateProfileStringA (value starting with t/T sets a bit in g_hglCoreFlags) and SmallTexure with GetPrivateProfileIntA (1 -> 0x08, 2 -> 0x10).

name: RegisterDrawCallback
notes: Registers a per-frame draw callback (0x495EA0 registers 0x495ED0 with 0x34).

name: SubmitScreenQuad
notes: Translucent quads (flag 0x80000000) are copied to the sorted draw queue, others are drawn now with DrawScreenQuad (call at 0x4A6EBE).

name: DrawScreenQuad
notes: Draws one rotated, scaled screen-space quad (sprite +7 x, +8 y, +9/+10 scale, +5 angle, +3 texture) with depth from the projection matrix. Every 2D element goes through here; squeezing x around 320 by 3/4 keeps 2D proportions in 16:9 (aspect_experiment 2).

name: SubmitModel
notes: Draws an opaque model record now (DrawModel, call at 0x4A72AF) or copies a translucent one to the sorted queue.

name: DrawModel
notes: SetTransform(WORLD, record +0x34) then draws the meshes of the model at record +0xC with DrawStrip3D / DrawList3D.

name: SubmitModelAlt
notes: Same as SubmitModel for DrawModelAlt (call at 0x4A77EF).

name: DrawModelAlt
notes: Second model draw variant with the same record layout as DrawModel (record flag 0x20000000 in the sorted queue).

name: FlushSortedDraws
notes: Sorts the translucent queue and draws its quads (DrawScreenQuad, call at 0x4A7DF9) and models (0x4A7310 / 0x4A7860).

name: SetMatrixMode
notes: Mode 3 = projection. Leaving mode 3 for 1 calls SetTransform(D3DTRANSFORMSTATE_PROJECTION, current matrix) and keeps a copy at g_projectionMatrix.

name: ScaleMatrix
signature: void __cdecl ScaleMatrix(float x, float y, float z)
notes: Scales the current matrix; UpdateLetterbox state 8 uses (1, 8, 1).

name: TranslateMatrix
signature: void __cdecl TranslateMatrix(float x, float y, float z)
notes: Multiplies the current matrix (g_currentMatrix) by a translation.

name: LoadIdentityMatrix
notes: Copies the identity matrix at 0x570210 into the current matrix.

name: DrawModelPointer
notes: Builds a model draw record from the current matrix and a model pointer and submits it (SubmitModel). Seen in the letterbox call chain.

name: SetPerspective
signature: void __cdecl SetPerspective(int fov, float aspect, float near, float far)
notes: Builds a D3D perspective matrix: m11 = cot(half fov), m00 = m11 / aspect, m22 = far/(far-near), m23 = 1, m32 = -m22*near; fov in 65536ths of a turn (0x1D3B = 41.1 deg vertical). Called only from 0x418590 and 0x419590.

name: EndFrameDraws
notes: FlushSortedDraws, then EndScene (0x4A4DA0).

name: SubmitSprite
notes: Builds a screen quad record from a sprite and passes it to SubmitScreenQuad. Only caller: DrawSprite2D.
